user.title: Bedtime Bridge
user.description: Choose what Snooze and Stop on your iPhone do in Home Assistant, and which entities the app should read when it plans your alarms.

data.wake_action: When you snooze or stop an alarm
data.shift_types: Shift types (comma separated, as they appear in calendar titles)

data_description.wake_action: Helpers: turn on the entities below, for blueprints that watch them (Wake Snooze Fade, Wake Sequence). Events: fire a bedtime_bridge event for automations and blueprints to trigger on. Both: do both.
data_description.shift_types: Each one gets a lead-time setting, and its name is sent as the alarm cause.

pair.title: Pair your iPhone
pair.description:
In the Bedtime Bridge app, open Settings › Home Assistant › Integration address and paste:

`{webhook_url}`

Keep it private: anyone with this address can send alarm updates. You can see it again later under this integration's Configure.
